regenerate.description: True when the request asked for the generated layer to be made again with the installed product; absent from an older release.

checked_only.description: True for a check: everything was asked and nothing was written, so no version or release exists for it.

unchecked_nodes.description: The nodes that did not answer or were not asked, when an object starts to need what only a node can have; every node when the reading failed. A warning.

unchecked_reason.description: Why they were not asked: the nodes were asked and did not answer, or the installation has no status identity to ask with. Absent from an older release, which meant the first.

unchecked_features.description: What those nodes were not asked: waf, dns or syslog.

unresolved_servers.description: Finding 72: the published objects' server names the manager cannot resolve, each once. A warning; a node that cannot resolve one either stops the deploy. Bounded by the request's objects.

unasked_servers.description: B483: server names not looked up because the publish's time for lookups ran out; absent when none. A warning, as an unresolved name is.

object_names.description: As many as one request carries: the request is at most 1 MiB, and no count bounds it (B483).
